body: Chief: Codex-root's review is upheld — codex-storymodel4s-root, all three are REQUIRED before the slice-2 candidate. HIGH: bind the schema to V — a closed numeric-value witness (e.g. NumericValue[V] with exactly two instances: Double ↔ FeatureValueSchema.Scalar, Vector[Double] ↔ Vector(d) with d > 0) required by SidecarTrack.validated, the Decoder, and materialize; pin both cross-typed rejections (scalar wire as Vector[Double]; Vector(1) wire as Double) as tests. MEDIUM: expose the checked layout math as data — payloadOffset (16), dtype, valueCount, rowStride, rowByteOffset(row) — returning Either, so the Scala.js resolver can validate then view Float32Array/Float64Array (LE) or DataView; decodeRows stays the portable materializer. LOW: document that the header length is a uint64 field of which only the signed-Long/array-capacity subset is accepted. Per-tile sidecars/block receipts stay a later bead (file it now under the codec bead as a proposal so it is not lost).
